verification: CI fixture HTTP through the FastAPI test client; tokens, grants and requests are fixture-local, not production.
assertions: A request naming brain hive-b is refused 403 brain_audience, recorded as one denial, and the error does not name hive-b.
A token issued for brain hive-b is refused before the body is read.

A project outside the grant is refused 403 project_grant without naming granted projects; query and intent text naming another brain and project leave scope at hive-a and alpha; a smuggled scope field is refused 422.
An engineer token posting lane ci is refused 403 role_grant; a router token may.
A 70 kB prompt is refused 413 before parsing; a query over 2000 characters and a max_tokens over 12000 are refused 422 without echoing input.
schema_version 1.0 is refused 422 unsupported_version before validation and before any denial is recorded.
Each refused request requires a new valid request; no fallback widens scope.
